provenance.sourceName: Copernicus Sentinel-2 L2A / Element 84 Earth Search

resolution.note: Red/NIR 10 m; SCL 20 m resampled nearest

provenance.citation: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2024–2026), served by Element 84.
Zanaga et al. (2022), ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, doi:10.5281/zenodo.7254221

scope: Small approximate pilot window within San Juan Valley, not the whole valley
unitDefinition: SLIC superpixels; not independently validated parcels

method.name: RandomForestClassifier
method.monthlyComposite: Pixel median of up to two lowest tile-cloud scenes per calendar month
method.parcelAggregation: Mean clear pixel NDVI; month missing if <50% of unit has clear pixels
method.seasonality: Standard deviation of the 12 calendar-month NDVI means
method.bareMonths: Count of observed monthly means <0.2; unobserved months excluded
method.seasonWindowStatus: Project heuristic; local rainfall and agronomist validation pending
method.mask: SCL 4/5 only with 20 m exclusion buffer; SCL has native 20 m resolution
method.confidence: Maximum uncalibrated predict_proba after fitting all weak labels; mean tree leaf class probability

weakLabelRules.bare_soil: WorldCover crop+bare fraction >=0.6 and latest observed monthly NDVI <0.2
weakLabelRules.crop: WorldCover crop fraction >=0.6 and latest observed monthly NDVI >=0.35
weakLabelRules.irrigation_signal: WorldCover crop fraction >=0.6, dry NDVI >=0.48 and dry >=wet-0.10
weakLabelRules.rainfed_signal: WorldCover crop fraction >=0.6, dry NDVI <=0.35, wet >=0.50 and wet-dry >=0.15

cover.limitation: Labels use the same NDVI features as the model. Agreement is circular and does not establish field accuracy or irrigation detection.

validation.interpretation: Descriptive agreement only; rare-class support is too small for generalization
validation.note: One spatial holdout; no field labels; no confidence interval; no tuning against holdout

waterRegime.limitation: Labels use the same NDVI features as the model. Agreement is circular and does not establish field accuracy or irrigation detection.
waterRegime.reason: Fixed spatial holdout lacks at least five train and one test unit per class; split was not searched for favorable metrics

limitations: Preliminary SLIC analysis unit, not a farm or cadastral boundary. Weak labels and uncalibrated model scores; no field validation. NDVI alone does not establish irrigation, crop identity or bare soil.
Validation measures agreement with feature-derived weak rules, not independent accuracy.
WorldCover is from 2021 and may be stale for 2024–2026.
Dry-season greenness may indicate perennial vegetation, rain or other conditions; no irrigation ground truth.
Two scenes per month can miss management events; cloud masks can contain errors.
2026 ends on the requested cutoff; November 2026 is partial.
Sentinel-2 is ESA/Copernicus, not NASA HLS or Landsat; NASA imagery integration remains pending.
